# UUID / ULID

Generate UUID v4, v7 or ULID; with an input, inspect it.

Category: Generators · ID: `uuid` · Search terms: guid, ulid, uuidv4, uuidv7, id

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui uuid [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. UUID or ULID to inspect (empty = generate)

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | `v4`, `v7`, `ulid` | `v4` | Version. |
| `--count` | 1–1000 | `1` | Count. |
| `--uppercase` | on/off | `false` | Uppercase. |
